dictionary.dev_guide_title: Developer Guide: Build Your 100% Independent Extension
dictionary.dev_guide_subtitle: Universal open architecture: create apps, games, agents, engines, or plugins in isolated folders without touching a single line of core system code.
dictionary.dev_pillar_zero_code_desc: No core system files (desktop, taskbar, tray, options) ever need edits. The system auto-discovers your directory.
dictionary.dev_pillar_manifest_desc: Declare where the app appears, what options to generate, and required capabilities in manifest.json.
dictionary.dev_pillar_zerotrust_desc: Isolated sandbox execution with granular permissions strictly verified and audited by the kernel.
dictionary.dev_pillar_distribution_desc: Distribute from any Git repository or remote URL. Users add your link and install in 1 click.
dictionary.dev_step_1_desc: Create an autonomous directory (e.g., client_web/src/apps/app_name/ or src/engines/...). It only contains its files: manifest.json, View.tsx, icon.png, and language/. Zero tight coupling with the core.
dictionary.dev_step_2_desc: Declare where to appear in the manifest: desktop (desktop icon), taskbar (pinned app or tray widget next to clock), or control panel. The window manager places it exactly as declared.
dictionary.dev_step_3_title: Step 3: Dynamic Auto-Creation of System Options
dictionary.dev_step_3_desc: Never modify the settings app! Define the options array in your manifest with types (boolean, range, select): Nuxiva auto-generates controls, sliders, and switches synchronized with runtime state.
dictionary.dev_step_4_title: Step 4: UI Development with React & System Hooks
dictionary.dev_step_4_desc: Develop View.tsx exporting the View component. Use useScopedI18n for 4-language localization and useOSApp to access window title, breadcrumbs, search query, and system status.
dictionary.dev_step_5_desc: Declare only required capabilities (e.g., local_storage, webgl2). Every app is wrapped in an isolated WindowErrorBoundary: if your app crashes, the operating system stays 100% active.
dictionary.dev_step_6_desc: At boot, the scanner discovers your new folder without recompiling core files. To distribute globally, host on any Git repo or publish directly to Nuxiva Store.
dictionary.dev_tip_perf_desc: The window manager loads View.tsx via React.lazy: your app consumes memory only when opened by the user. Use React.memo and useMemo to prevent unnecessary calculations.
dictionary.dev_tip_clean_title: Nuxiva Code Standard: Zero Comments & Line Limit
dictionary.dev_tip_clean_desc: Nuxiva requires clean, self-documenting code without comments and strictly under 500 lines per file. Split complex components into dedicated submodules.
dictionary.dev_tip_i18n_desc: Always provide it.json, en.json, es.json, and fr.json in your language/ directory. All keys must match symmetrically for worldwide adoption.
